component.name: AudioMagic
component.summary: Record several microphones, programs and streams at once

description.p: A simple multitrack recorder built on PipeWire. Each microphone, interface input, program (a call, a browser, a game) or internet stream gets its own track with its own level, pan, mute, solo, monitoring and effects.

ul.li: Record up to 8 or more inputs at once, kept in sync
Noise suppression, gate and EQ per track
Export the mix and each track as FLAC, MP3, Ogg Opus, Ogg Vorbis or WAV
